text:
Ana: Quick heads up — can we move next week's ARB from Thu 10am to Wed 2pm? I need a facilitator swap and a compact agenda. Quick yes/no by EOD pls.
Priya: I can facilitate Wed 2pm if that works. :hand:
Jamal: Wed 2 works for me. Can we add the KV-cache RFC (RFC-324) to the triage? It's timeboxed 10 min.
Kai: I'm +1 but prefer 45m slot if we have 3 substantive items. Otherwise 30m if it's mostly quick reviews.
scheduling-bot: Calendar invite created: ARB — Wed, 2:00 PM — 45m. Guests: eng-platform. Link: https://calendar.example/evt/abcd
Ana: Thanks @Priya — could you take facilitator notes? Also can you confirm guest slot for infra team (they wanted 5 min for CI perf)?
Priya: Yep I can take notes. Guest slot ok — add to agenda.
Jamal: Proposed agenda snippet:
```
1) Quick updates (5m)
2) KV-cache RFC (10m)
3) Platform standards: model rollout policy (15m)
4) Infra guest: CI perf (5m)
5) AOB + action review (10m)
```
Kai: Suggest swapping 2 & 3 so platform policy gets full contiguous time.
Ana: Good call. Updated agenda below — Priya, can you publish this as the pre-read on the doc?
```
- 2:00 — Quick status (Ana)
- 2:05 — Platform rollout policy (Kai) — doc: docs/rollout-policy.md
- 2:20 — KV-cache RFC (Jamal) — RFC-324
- 2:30 — Infra guest: CI perf (Marcus) — 5m
- 2:35 — AOB + actions (All)
```
Priya: Will post pre-read and set slides link. Also tagging @Marcus to confirm guest time.
Marcus: Confirmed, I'll keep it to 5 min and drop slides in the doc.
Jamal: Tiny ask — can we lock in the post-meeting action owner for KV-cache? Prefer to call it out during review.
Ana: Agreed. I'll call for owners during wrap-up.
Priya: Final note — if anyone can't make Wed 2, ping here now. Otherwise I'll send the final invite + doc link by EOD today. :calendar:
Kai: I'll be there. :thumbsup:
Ana: Awesome. Thanks all.
